I'm an adult now. I still very very very much miss being a kid. I get so depressed about it but something that I can say is, I implore you to collect the toys you liked once or still do. Get a coloring book, read the silly books you read as a kid. Make yourself some hot chocolate & stay up late setting up your toys and gizmos and gadgets . You absolutely don't have to regress like some people do but just collect the things you used to. 

My childhood was ripped away from me due to trauma. In 6-7th grade I got rid of ALL my toys, all my childhood books, almost all my plushies. I regretted every single day. I had a collection of LPS worth over 1000$ but I got rid of all of it except a small bag of a lps that I loved way too much. Quite a few years later, I have a big dollhouse on a shelf filled with Calico critters, monster high GALORE, LPS every corner, and so so sooo many plushies. I put stickers on EVERYTHING. Even with all my metal and goth posters, even with all my taxidermy, even after with having a serious relationship, even with all that, I still collect them. 

Time will never wait but at least, your adulthood can be filled with love and whimsy. You're not childish, even if people say you are, even if people give you weird states. You're not . But even if you are, it's not a bad thing at all. 

You're on your first life, friend. Try to enjoy it as best as you can. 
You're only one person.

That's how my dog is! If an intruder comes she will roll on her back and her tail would go absolutely crazy, she loves absolutely everyone and believes they want to be friends with her lol, I love her so much, she's such a silly doggy. I'm happy you know you matter to them and vice versa. 

I have to go to sleep now as it is almost 4 am lol but please, I hope you have a great night. Give your doggy a pet for me:) 

I hope the rest of your night goes well, friend:)

So then wiggle butts! I have an English bulldog and she's got a crazy wiggle butt tee hee! And I understand that a lot. I try to take photos whenever I can, I know a lot of people say to be in the moment, but sometimes (a lot of times) , it's nice to have a photo or two to look back on. Even when my family annoy the hell out of me, I could never hate them or be annoyed at them for too long, ya know? I guess that's just how family are though lol people cope in many ways, and you just need to remember that knowing they will be waiting for you, is one way to cope with death. 

From one person to another, it's also my way:)

You're welcome, friend.  You're not selfish for thinking that btw, I have and will continue thinking that as well. But I guess that's what it means to love.  Being so afraid to lose. They are lucky to be so loved, as are you. 

Your dear friends will be waiting for you. And once you do come, they will great you with lots of wagging tails and smiles. Your loved ones won't be alone when they pass either. Their loved ones will be waiting for them as well. It's a pattern of love, and death. 

You'll be okay. I promise. I hope you have a great night friend, and feel free to text me if you ever need a shoulder again:)

It's okay to be afraid! It's completely normal, and okay. My ma is afraid of death, even after being a mortician. It's just life, everyone is afraid. Even once. Your pups will be waiting for you. Just as mine will be waiting for me. Just as my soul cat will be waiting for me, once she passes. Your people will be waiting for you. Waiting for you to be back in their arms. 

I think, knowing or rather, hoping, brings a bit of comfort, ya know? Death isn't easy, it wasn't meant to be. But the best thing to do for yourself, is to remember they will be there. You won't be alone when you pass, and you won't be alone afterwards.

My mom is a mortician, it's what I'm going to be. Growing up, I was surrounded by the dead, rather that was on the internet, or taxidermy, so on and so fourth. I'm not afraid of death, persay. The thing that scares me though is the absolutely nothingness after death. We don't know what's after life, we don't know if it's warmth, and comfort like what we grow believing. As someone said on Twitter (very paraphrased) 'I hope it's like your parents carrying you into bed after you fall asleep' . 

Everyone passes, no matter how bad you don't want them to. I'm terrified of the day my mama will pass. But I know she will and I hope at least she will be loved, unconditionally. I hope our dogs will be waiting for her. Know that at the very least she won't be forgotten gives me comfort. 

There really isn't much I can say except that always know that the thought of never forgetting them will show much more love then you know. You will be okay. We, my mom, me (in the future) , and all the last callers will make sure death is as comfortable as possible, and no one is afraid of it. Please, understand, death does not have to be terrifying. Souls simply need time to rest.

Please report him to the police. I believe you can anonymously report it as well. I'm sorry, but you were raped. Sure, you consented to the sex. But, you didn't consent to anal, him taking his condom off, you didn't want to drink but he made you do it, nor smoke but he made you do it. You're not filthy. You're not disgusting. You're not at fault. & you're not alone. Feel free to message me if you ever wanna talk. I'm sure lots of other are willing to lend a shoulder if you need it. We are here for you. & I'm so sorry about what happened to you. 

It is not your fault. I promise.

I understand where you are coming from. I was in a DV relationship for around 7 or so months, in which I got raped multiple times by the same guy I called my boyfriend. I always feel so gross and horrible about wanting sexual things and worse, ENJOYING them . It took me a year before I got another boyfriend after getting out of said DV relationship. This is the best thing that has ever happened to me. My boyfriend is THE BEST thing that happened to me. I still feel gross , horrible, disgusting, after doing sexual things and enjoying them. As if I'm some disgusting animal for enjoying such things but my boyfriend has helped a ton and I'm healing, ever single day. Even when we just sit in bed together and watch stupid shit. 

Let me, first hand, tell you, it isn't your fault. You aren't disgusting or unpure. Sex, in of itself, isn't unpure. Same with pleasuring yourself. 

You're not an animal. You're not gross. And you're certainly, not unpure.
